name: Elk, Giant
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Ability modifiers STR +4, DEX +3, CON +2, INT -2, WIS +2, CHA +0. Perception 14. Stealth 13. Senses None. Languages Giant Elk. Understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan without speaking them.
appearance: A heavy brown elk with a dark mane and a wide rack of branching antlers.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol’s licensed Spanish edition, Cubil de Monstruos (2025), p. 333, Alce gigante.
sections.Traits: Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Ram on the same turn to add 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit this way must also make a DC 14 STR save or fall prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Ram and one Kick.
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Kick. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be pushed up to 15 ft. away from the elk.
sections.Bonus actions: Bolstering Bugle (27 HP or higher). The elk bellows at its opponents and gains advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn.

name: Frog
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR -5, DEX +0, CON -1, INT -5, WIS -1, CHA -4. Perception 11. Stealth 10. Senses Darkvision 30 ft. Languages None. Resistant to grappled. Apply advantage to rolls and saves to avoid or end that condition.
appearance: A small olive frog with mottled skin, a pale jaw, and folded hind legs.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol’s licensed Spanish edition, Cubil de Monstruos (2025), p. 352, Rana.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The frog breathes air and water.
Standing Leap. It can jump up to 10 ft. horizontally or 5 ft. vertically with or without a running start.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Frog, Giant
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR +2, DEX +1, CON +0, INT -4, WIS +0, CHA -4. Perception 12. Stealth 11. Senses Darkvision 30 ft. Languages None. Resistant to grappled. Apply advantage to rolls and saves to avoid or end that condition.
appearance: A stocky olive and tan frog with dark speckles and broad webbed hind feet.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol’s licensed Spanish edition, Cubil de Monstruos (2025), pp. 352–353, Rana gigante.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The frog breathes air and water.
Standing Leap. It can jump up to 20 ft. horizontally or 10 ft. vertically with or without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and grapple the target (escape DC 12). The target remains restrained, and the frog cannot Bite another target until the grapple ends.
Swallow. Make one Bite attack against a Small or smaller target the frog is grappling. On a hit, the frog swallows it and ends the grapple. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, has total cover from attacks and other effects outside the frog, and takes 5 (2d4) acid damage at the start of each of the frog’s turns. The frog can hold one swallowed target at a time. If the swallowed creature damages the frog, the frog makes a DC 10 CON save at the end of that turn. On a failure, it regurgitates the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 ft. of the frog. If the frog dies, it stops restraining the swallowed creature. The creature can spend 5 ft. of movement to escape the corpse and exits prone.
sections.Bonus actions: Reeling Tongue. Choose one Medium or smaller creature the frog can see within 15 ft. The creature must make a DC 12 STR save or be pulled up to 10 ft. closer to the frog.

name: Frog, Giant Poisonous
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR +3, DEX +1, CON +1, INT -4, WIS +0, CHA -4. Perception 10. Stealth 11. Senses Darkvision 30 ft. Languages None.
appearance: A large frog with striking yellow and black markings and spread toes.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol’s licensed Spanish edition, Cubil de Monstruos (2025), p. 353, Rana, Gigante Venenosa.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The frog breathes air and water.
Standing Leap. It can jump up to 20 ft. horizontally or 10 ft. vertically with or without a running start.
Toxic Skin. A creature that touches the frog or hits it with a melee attack within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 CON save. On a failure, it is poisoned until the end of its next turn and has mild hallucinations while poisoned.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing plus 5 (1d10) poison damage and grapple the target (escape DC 13). The target remains restrained, and the frog cannot Bite another target until the grapple ends.
Swallow. Make one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target the frog is grappling. On a hit, the frog swallows it and ends the grapple. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, has total cover from attacks and other effects outside the frog, and takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of the frog’s turns. The frog can hold one swallowed target at a time. If the swallowed creature damages the frog, the frog makes a DC 11 CON save at the end of that turn. On a failure, it regurgitates the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 ft. of the frog. If the frog dies, it stops restraining the swallowed creature. The creature can spend 5 ft. of movement to escape the corpse and exits prone.
sections.Bonus actions: Reeling Tongue. Choose one Medium or smaller creature the frog can see within 20 ft. The creature must make a DC 13 STR save or be pulled up to 15 ft. closer to the frog.
sections.Source note: Cubil de Monstruos p. 353 gives Reeling Tongue a Medium-or-smaller target limit. The English Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.4 gives Large or smaller. This profile follows the Spanish Monster Vault printing.
